name: Camping 101: Fishing

angles.text: As an Alliance angler, you can visit Astaia in Darnassus to learn campsite craft.
As a cook, your basic training helps you make the campfire every camp needs.

faq.answer: Astaia in Darnassus teaches experienced fishermen to craft a decorative Fish Bowl for camp once they show proficiency in fishing.
faq.q: Who teaches you how to craft camping items for fishing?

faq.answer: A Fish Bowl brings comfort and joy to resting adventurers. A happy, well-rested camper fights with renewed vigor on outdoor journeys.
faq.q: What purpose does a Fish Bowl serve at camp?

faq.answer: You cannot pitch a camp in the heart of a settlement or town center. Head into the wilderness to set up camp and place fixtures such as a Fish Bowl.
faq.q: Can you set up a camp inside Darnassus or other cities?

aliases: what do you need for a camp
faq.answer: A basic campfire is required for a campsite. Visit a cooking trainer to learn how to kindle one before establishing a wilderness camp.
faq.q: What is required before setting up a camp?

aliases: when can i learn fish bowl
faq.answer: Yes. An adventurer must first demonstrate proficiency in fishing to learn the craft from Astaia.
faq.q: Do you need fishing skill to learn how to craft a Fish Bowl?

faq.answer: A camp gives outdoor travelers a place to rest and find morale-boosting comforts such as a Fish Bowl, helping them stay rested and capable in the wilderness.
faq.q: Why do adventurers set up camps in the wild?

sections.body: Anglers crossing Kalimdor can put quiet hours by the water to use. In Darnassus, Astaia teaches experienced fishermen to turn their catches and skill into campsite comforts. One of these is a Fish Bowl, made to display at camp and bring cheer to weary travelers.
sections.title: Comfort at the Campsite

sections.body: A wilderness camp needs more than fishing gear. You cannot pitch one in a crowded city center or urban district, so you must find open ground. Every camp also needs a warm fire. Visit a local cooking trainer to learn basic fire-making before settling down for the night.
sections.title: Wilderness Necessities

summary: In Darnassus, anglers are directed to Astaia to learn how a Fish Bowl can brighten a wilderness camp. The craft rewards skilled fishermen with a touch of comfort for life outdoors.
